title: Task- and Session-Level Model Routing: A Common-Interface Hybrid Evaluation of Four Open-Source Routers Across Four Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2608.14641v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic systems increasingly delegate model selection to a router, yet open-source routers are usually evaluated with different tasks, candidate pools, and execution protocols, limiting direct comparison. We present a common measurement protocol and hybrid evaluation of four router implementations across RouterBench, BFCL v4, tau2-bench, and WebArena. We evaluate 290 frozen tasks against a locked matrix of 2,610 candidate outcomes. Three routers emit constant or near-constant tier assignments; only vLLM Semantic Router varies materially with prompt content, and it has the highest observed success rate on none of the four benchmarks. Always-Mid matches Aurelio exactly on three benchmarks and within 0.003 on the fourth. For vLLM, task-level superiority tests detect no task-specific advantage over a share-matched content-blind allocation; equivalence is established only on WebArena at the protocol-declared five-percentage-point margin. translated_title: 任务与会话级模型路由：四个开源路由器在四个基准上的通用接口混合评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14641v1 公告类型：新  摘要：代理系统越来越多地将模型选择委托给路由器，然而开源路由器通常在不同的任务、候选池和执行协议下进行评估，限制了直接比较。我们提出了一种通用测量协议，并对四个路由器实现（RouterBench、BFCL v4、tau2-bench和WebArena）进行了混合评估。我们针对锁定矩阵中的2，610个候选结果评估了290个冻结任务。三个路由器发出恒定或接近恒定的层级分配；只有vLLM语义路由器随提示内容实质性变化，并且在四个基准中的任何一个上都没有观察到最高的成功率。Always-Mid在三个基准上与Aurelio完全匹配，在第四个基准上差异在0.003以内。对于vLLM，任务级优越性测试未检测到相对于共享匹配的内容无关分配的任何特定任务优势；仅在WebArena上，在协议声明的五个百分点边际内确立了等价性。
tldr: 本文提出一种通用测量协议，对四个开源路由器在四个基准上进行混合评估，发现大多数路由器输出恒定层级，仅vLLM语义路由器随内容变化，但无基准上表现最优，且未发现其任务级优势。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a common measurement protocol and hybrid evaluation of four open-source routers across four benchmarks, finding that most routers emit constant tier assignments, only vLLM Semantic Router varies with content but achieves no top performance, and no task-level advantage is detected.
